decision: Reject all three candidates: no demonstrated overall explanation-accuracy gain. Restore prompt v100/core v12; the two original issues remain unresolved.

methodology.review: Same-agent manual review of public paragraphs and cards against supplied request facts; not independent or statistically powered.
methodology.coverage: Four scopes, Singles and Doubles, KO and EN across each pair; eight reused sourced-team cases, not eight new held-out teams.
methodology.targetRubric: Unqualified former-ability advice or incorrect current/Mega defensive-state claims; incorrect zero-investment or candidate/baseline stat-tradeoff claims. Related state and sibling errors are included, with exact evidence per record.
methodology.limitations: No target mention is not proof of a correct explicit explanation. Other-issue notes are review observations, not an exhaustive accuracy score. No validators or prose rewriting were added.
methodology.pricing: Recorded estimates use repository usage accounting. No-cache counterfactual uses repository GPT-6 Luna short-context rates, input $0.10/M and output $0.50/M; not an invoice.
